<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="rise-of-the-six-basic" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Rise of the Six Basic</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/boe0MAWJIW.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Rise of the Six (RotS) is a follow-up to the original Barrows Brothers encounter. Players, in groups of sizes 1 to 4, will take the six brothers in a cave-like arena. The brothers in RotS are significantly stronger than in the original encounter, and have deadly mechanics.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>After successfully killing all brothers, the player is tasked with escaping from the cave through a randomly generated tunnel.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Please note that you can attune your Barrows portal in War's Retreat directly to the Rise of the Six well, as shown </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/NB0HcoM.png <nowiki>here</nowiki>]<nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="presets-and-relics"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=pmFdFBCEsQgOGqBVVDBQ <nowiki>Ranged preset</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/5e8efbb2c54ed148316867bf8cf5bf25a01d4a8f61e7fd13da5852738b2ca533.webp" alt="Unnamed preset" kind="addition" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=KVD8GZMr7eb8REIakJdv <nowiki>Necromancy preset</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>​
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FKVD8GZMr7eb8REIakJdv.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="arena-overview"><ins><nowiki>Arena Overview</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The RotS arena is unique in that it is randomly generated for each and every kill. The path may twist and turn, and features a host of gaps, crossed by bridges. At the end of the tunnel there are four pads. In order to enter the final section of the arena, where the fight takes place, every player must stand on a pad.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/JQrja8Q.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="mechanics"><ins><nowiki>Mechanics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="brothers"><nowiki>Brothers</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The mechanics encountered are described on a brother-by-brother basis. As a general rule of thumb: </nowiki><strong><nowiki>if something looks bad in RotS, it probably is</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>There are some mechanics that are shared across all brothers. Namely:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Shadow Realm</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A random brother will pull all players into the shadow realm.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The screen will turn a shade of grey, and all brothers will deal increased damage (including their special mechanics).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Healing</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Upon killing a brother, a bar will be placed above their heads.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If the bar is filled, all deceased brothers will return to life.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Killing another brother will reset all bars back to empty.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Some other mechanics are shared between just a few brothers:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Hurricane</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• All melee brothers (Dharok, Guthan, Torag, Verac).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Brother will slow down and spin in a circle, dealing rapid damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Stay away from them!</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Wall Slam</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dharok, Torag, Verac.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Brother will jump off the wall, and deal damage in a 5x5 area on landing.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Run away before it lands!</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Lightning Conductor / Turret of Fire</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Karil and Ahrim, respectively.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Spin around shooting energy out of their hands and become immune to damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Stay away from them!</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Teleport</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Karil or Ahrim will teleport up high in the centre of the arena.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Karil will then unleash lightning across the other side of the arena.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Surge through the lightning, or move sideways to dodge it.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ahrim will then unleash purple and red gas pits that deal damage if stood upon.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Do not step on the pits!</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Throw</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Karil or Ahrim will be thrown across the room in a random direction, dealing damage if stuck under them.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Finally, each brother has its own unique mechanics, as described below:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Ahrim, the Blighted</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Attacks with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Special</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Flight
    • </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Mechanic</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: levitates in the air, gaining full immunity against </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage, and 50% reduction in </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage
    • </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Strategy</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: continue to deal damage as normal, unless using magic or melee (switch to another target, if so)
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="tunnel-escape"><nowiki>Tunnel Escape</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>In general, your goal is to reach the end of the tunnel and climb the rope, as fast as possible. In doing so, you will have to navigate around fallen obstacles, as well as cross gaps - these gaps were previously home to bridges; however, they are destroyed before the escape.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Make sure that all players have looted the chest and are ready to proceed before starting the escape. It only takes one person crossing the line to trigger the tunnel collapse.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Each previous bridge is replaced with two options: a ledge on the side of the gap, and a pedestal/vine in the middle of the gap. It is recommended to save the pedestal/vine for the last person crossing the gap. Players farther up should instead use the ledge.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/5hxreuy.jpg" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>While navigating the tunnel, it is recommended to use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as much as possible, preferably with the Mobile </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501908628799488.png?v=1" alt="mob" title="mob" kind="icon" /><nowiki> perk in effect. It is recommended to use a Powerburst of Acceleration </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756236265472524418.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofacceleration" title="powerburstofacceleration" kind="icon" /><nowiki> during the escape so that </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be used repeatedly, for a short while.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>As the countdown continues, you may notice your screen tilting and shaking more aggressively. If desired, it can be helpful to turn this off in settings: </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Gameplay &gt; Camera &gt; System &gt; Camera Shake</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="basic-strategy"><ins><nowiki>Basic Strategy</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Keep in mind the golden rule of RotS: </nowiki><strong><nowiki>if it looks bad, it is</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Players in a group should split sides; for example, one experienced player soloing one side, and two less experienced players duoing the other side. Or, a solo/duo on either side.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Once everyone is inside the final arena, take position and prepare for the fight. If duoing a side, it is recommended to position as shown below, with one player holding aggro of the brothers (green diamond), and the other DPSing from a safe distance (blue square). The player holding aggro of the brothers can 'kite' as required in order to keep themselves safe. The player holding aggro should also use Incite </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/553050196725071893.png?v=1" alt="Incite" title="Incite" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. Once positioned, players can start the fight by right-clicking the shadow portal in the middle of the arena.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/FdM5SZz.jpg" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Prioritising </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Karil first</nowiki></strong><nowiki> is recommended, followed by Torag. Largely speaking, the other brothers can be killed with less urgency. Keep in mind the mechanics of each brother, and kite as necessary so as to delay or avoid their special attacks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="more-advanced-positioning"><nowiki>More Advanced Positioning</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>After gaining a bit of experience, it is possible to experiment with positioning. Both players can activate Soul Link </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/989442220484616242.png?v=1" alt="soullink" title="soullink" kind="icon" /><nowiki> curse, stand on the same square, and don’t move unless necessary. The player using Incite </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/553050196725071893.png?v=1" alt="Incite" title="Incite" kind="icon" /><nowiki> will </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMelee" title="DeflectMelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and the DPSer can </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/989442220484616242.png?v=1" alt="soullink" title="soullink" kind="icon" /><nowiki> splits both the damage taken and health healed between the two players. This allows the incite to stay healthy while not moving, maintaining the stack of brothers and effectiveness of chins.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
      
    </nowiki>
